To make a simple tomato pasta, heat olive oil in a wide pan and fry two cloves of sliced garlic until golden. def merge_sorted(left, right):
    result = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            result.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    result.extend(left[i:])
    result.extend(right[j:])
    return result

print(merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3, 10]))

The Western Ghats are a mountain range that runs parallel to the western coast of the Indian peninsula for about 1,600 kilometres. They are a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the world's biodiversity hotspots, home to many species of plants, amphibians and birds found nowhere else. The range strongly influences the monsoon climate.
